entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 3 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Attack using a weapon infused with the power of light, weakening them up to 6 times, lasting 10 seconds. Your foes are commanded by the light, reducing their outgoing damage, Crit Chance, and Hit Chance by 5%, and Dodge and Defense by 10% per stack. Undead foes take extra damage from the holy light.
notes: Deals 150% Weapon Damage to non-Undead enemies. Deals 375% Weapon Damage to Undead enemies.
Applies Divine, reducing enemy Dodge by 10% per stack, stacks up to 6 and lasts 10 seconds.
Applies Commandent, reducing enemy Defense by 10% per stack, stacks up to 6 and lasts 10 seconds.
Applies Eminent, reducing enemy Hit Chance, outgoing damage, and Crit Chance all by 5%, stacks up to 6 and lasts 10 seconds.

entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 3 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Invoke your most powerful holy light spell, dealing massive damage to your foes. If your foes are sealed, your holy magic is even stronger, breaking the seal and doing double damage. The effects of the Broken Seal linger, reducing your opponent’s damage dealt by 15% for 25 seconds, stacking up to 2.
notes: If Righteous Seal is in effect, deals 1100% Spell Damage, consumes Righteous Seal and applies Broken Seal, reducing opponent's damage dealt by 15% for 25 seconds, stacking to 2.
